notes: The Roux Institute is Northeastern's applied-research/professional-education campus in Portland, ME. Its 'Our People' page lists well over 100 people, overwhelmingly part-time lecturers, teaching professors, research scientists/assistants, and program/career-services staff rather than independent PI-led research labs; research is organized by broad area (Human Data Interaction, Life Sciences & Health, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Environmental Health & Safety) rather than named labs with individual PIs. Did not individually enumerate the full roster given this structure -- recorded only top leadership. Several names here are faculty/researchers also appearing in other Northeastern source files (e.g. Samuel Scarpino/EAI, Matteo Chinazzi/NetSI); not deduplicated across files, per existing project convention.
